context: Tests whether the agent achieves comprehensive coverage of all decision branches in a migration plan without stopping early, structures questions individually with recommended answers, and produces the correct summary format at the end.

checklist.name: No plan modification
checklist.description: The file inputs/migration-plan.md is not modified by the agent

checklist.name: Recommended answer per question
checklist.description: Every challenge question or decision point includes the agent's own recommended answer or position — not just the question

checklist.name: Questions individually structured
checklist.description: Challenge questions are presented individually (numbered or visually separated one at a time), not grouped into multi-part compound blocks

checklist.name: Trade-offs addressed
checklist.description: At least one trade-off is explicitly called out (e.g. dual-write consistency vs complexity, strangler fig timing, or sprint scope)

checklist.name: Edge cases addressed
checklist.description: At least one edge case is identified (e.g. in-flight transactions during cutover, foreign-key relationships between domains, or partial failure during dual-write)

checklist.name: Missing alternatives addressed
checklist.description: At least one missing alternative is raised (e.g. event sourcing vs dual-write, phased cutover vs big-bang, or alternative tooling for data sync)

checklist.name: Unstated assumptions addressed
checklist.description: At least one unstated assumption is surfaced (e.g. no timeline specified for sprints, no rollback plan, or assumption that backfill completes without downtime)

checklist.name: Dependencies addressed
checklist.description: At least one dependency or risk not mentioned in the plan is raised (e.g. cross-domain data consistency, service team readiness, or monitoring during cutover)

checklist.name: At least 5 distinct decision areas
checklist.description: The report addresses at least 5 distinct decision areas or challenge topics — demonstrating that the agent did not stop after the first few issues

checklist.name: Decisions Made section
checklist.description: The report includes a 'Decisions Made' section (or equivalent heading) with at least 2 numbered decisions reached

checklist.name: Decisions include reasons
checklist.description: Each entry in the 'Decisions Made' section includes a reason or rationale alongside the decision

checklist.name: Changes to Apply section
checklist.description: The report includes a 'Changes to Apply' section (or equivalent heading) with at least 2 concrete changes for the plan
